# Nexlyr Solutions

> Nexlyr Solutions is a digital agency working with clients worldwide, with its base in Karachi, Pakistan. One team builds hand-coded websites, web apps, AI chatbots and AI calling agents, custom business software (POS, inventory, booking, admin panels), and runs video editing, logo and brand design, and social media marketing with Meta and Google ads. It also sets up NFC business cards and Google review stands.

Every 5-page website includes a free AI chatbot trained on the business and basic SEO on every page. Prices are quoted per project after a conversation; there is no price list.

## Services
- [Website design & development](https://nexlyr.solutions/web-development): hand-coded websites, web apps, e-commerce, admin panels, AI chatbots, AI calling agents, SEO (basic, advanced, technical, local)
- [Business software](https://nexlyr.solutions/business-software): stock and inventory, POS and billing, salon and barber booking, clinic records, gym memberships, school portals, restaurant ordering, real estate, admin panels
- [Video editing](https://nexlyr.solutions/video-editing): Instagram Reels and Shorts, long-form YouTube, multicam podcasts, motion graphics, ad creative, AI UGC ads, thumbnails, events
- [Logo design, branding & paid ads](https://nexlyr.solutions/design-and-ads): logos, brand identity systems, social creatives, print and packaging, Meta and Google campaigns
- [Social media marketing](https://nexlyr.solutions/social-media-marketing): content calendars, reels, carousels, community management, Meta and Instagram ads, monthly reporting
- [NFC business cards & Google reviews](https://nexlyr.solutions/#tap)

## Client portal
- Every client gets a private portal at https://portal.nexlyr.solutions/ with live project steps, daily updates, invoices and verifiable receipts, step comments, final files and add-on requests. Clients sign in with a Client ID and password.
